items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: someone told me, the guy that used to run Pasquale’s out here, Pat Senatore, the bass player

ctx.x: No kidding. What does Madonna’s brother do?
Well you know I’m not really sure except he hasn’t announced it too much but someone told me, the guy that used to run Pasquale’s out here, Pat Senatore, the bass player—
No, but is he a singer or something?
